title: Everyday Phrases — The Rush-Hour Commute
scene_zh: 高峰通勤 · 情境對話
title_quote: The alarm went off at six.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🚇 實用高峰通勤必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — The Rush-Hour Commute
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用高峰通勤情境對話：早起趕車、刷卡進站、車廂擁擠讓座、報站坐過站、換乘公交堵車改道、到公司吐槽晚高峰錯峰回家（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical The Rush-Hour Commute phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from tapping your card at the gate to crowded trains, bus detours and off-peak rides home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The alarm went off at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I must catch the early train.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are my dark blue socks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're in the dryer, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pack my lunch already?
dialogue.zh: 你幫我把午餐收好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's inside your work bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I left them on the kitchen table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft ðɛm ɑn ðə ˈkɪʧən ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 我把它落在廚房桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the jacket by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me when you get in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你看看，街上已經這麼多車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone leaves at the same time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I walk fast to save minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coffee is still too hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the cup by the lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bus stop still closed?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only two blocks to the station.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll reach it in five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait for me at the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll stand by the sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that near miss?
dialogue.zh: 剛剛那一下好險，你看到沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That scooter driver goes too fast.
dialogue.zh: 那個騎機車的開太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only cross when the light walks.
dialogue.zh: 要等行人綠燈才過馬路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I always wait for the green man.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlweɪz weɪt fər ðə ɡrin mæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gates are already open up ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Join it near the ticket machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need paper tickets now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much money is on my card?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌʧ ˈmʌni ɪz ɑn maɪ kɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add twenty so you don't get stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ˈtwɛnti soʊ ju doʊnt ɡɛt stʌk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the one near the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the small symbol at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə smɔl ˈsɪmbəl æt ðə ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就是閘門上那個小標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這次它閃紅燈嗶了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again and hold it steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh great, my bag got stuck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift it over the low bar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天坐電扶梯還是走樓梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Escalator, but stand on the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red one, from track two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is track two on this level?
dialogue.zh: 二號月台就在這一層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind my bag for one second.
dialogue.zh: 幫我看一下包，馬上回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That map up top is confusing.
dialogue.zh: 上面那張路線圖真讓人糊塗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the bathroom on this floor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past the vending machines, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðə ˈvɛndɪŋ məˈʃinz, ɑn ðə lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 過了自動販賣機，左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad news, the board says we're delayed.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd nuz, ðə bɔrd sɛz wɪr dɪˈleɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes, it just told us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hate waiting with so many people.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ heɪt ˈweɪtɪŋ wɪð soʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 我討厭這麼多人一起等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left a newspaper on the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɛft ə ˈnuzˌpeɪpər ɑn ðə bɛnʧ./
dialogue.zh: 有人把報紙留在長椅上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, you still have time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wind pushes air up here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the train is close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand back from the yellow line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon, the doors opened with a beep.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun, ðə dɔrz ˈoʊpənd wɪð ə bip./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let people off before you board.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then squeeze in from the side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got in but lost my hat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt ɪn bʌt lɔst maɪ hæt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, was it your favorite?
dialogue.zh: 不會吧，那是你最愛的那頂？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doors are closing, don't push.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it onto the train.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Find a spot while you still can.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd ə spɑt waɪl ju stɪl kæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the one near the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man already claimed that spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stand and hold the pole.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone has one bar left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hard part is just starting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, you stepped on my shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, ju stɛpt ɑn maɪ ʃuː./
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，你踩到我的鞋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm really sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just give me a second.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I smell it from here too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I give this lady my seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ɡiv ðɪs ˈleɪdi maɪ sit?/
dialogue.zh: 我該不該把位子讓給她？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I only ride two stops.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A young man took three of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə jʌŋ mæn tʊk θri ʌv ðɛm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I say something to him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I heard one guy groan loudly.
dialogue.zh: 我聽見有個男生很大聲地唉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the voice is unclear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It said something about a signal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much longer will we wait?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I said the train was delayed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有位女士的買菜袋掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did anyone help her pick them up?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈɛniˌwʌn hɛlp hɜr pɪk ðɛm ʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two students knelt down right away.
dialogue.zh: 兩個學生馬上蹲下去撿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please answer it outside the car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That man is on speaker phone.
dialogue.zh: 那個男人在開擴音講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask them to stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our station is the next stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 借過，我要在這一站下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the doors opened right on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, ðə dɔrz ˈoʊpənd raɪt ɑn taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we miss our exit sign?
dialogue.zh: 我們是不是錯過出口指標？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, exit one is still ahead.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，一號出口還在前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, this gate ate my card.
dialogue.zh: 不妙，閘門把我的卡吞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the attendant by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a line at the booth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It moves slower than the train.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky you won't miss the bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is the transfer point?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the numbers on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on this bench a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next train comes in two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That machine just took my dollar.
dialogue.zh: 那台販賣機吞了我一塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the button on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab it before someone else does.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than no water at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again, the platform filled up fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same crowd from the last train.
dialogue.zh: 都是上一班下來的那批人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們在車頭那一頭等吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That car is usually less packed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I dozed off for one minute.
dialogue.zh: 我不小心打瞌睡了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, the noise puts me to sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə nɔɪz pʊts mi tə slip./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the doors just pinged twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means they're about to close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set an alert for my stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛt ən əˈlɜrt fər maɪ stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我要替我的站設個提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, now we can rest a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, naʊ wi kæn rɛst ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，現在可以休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們搭那班區間公車吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's full, but we can squeeze.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh oh, the bus lane is blocked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ oʊ, ðə bʌs leɪn ɪz blɑkt./
dialogue.zh: 糟了，公車專用道被堵死。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we sit in regular traffic.
dialogue.zh: 所以只能卡在一般車陣裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand behind the pole with me.
dialogue.zh: 跟我一起站在桿子後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 為什麼所有人都停著不動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brake lights are all red.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, just a lot of broken glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ʤʌst ə lɑt ʌv ˈbroʊkən ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只是碎了一地玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 所以車陣塞了好幾個街區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell them the bus is stuck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些小路反而沒什麼車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my stop is still far.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus is skipping our stop.
dialogue.zh: 公車好像要跳過我們那站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But why would it skip us?
dialogue.zh: 但它為什麼要跳過我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The road there is closed today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then get off at the next one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡɛt ɔf æt ðə nɛkst wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait ten minutes, it may drop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good news, the app found one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it at the corner yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand where the light is bright.
dialogue.zh: 站在燈光亮一點的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 嘿，那司機按了一聲喇叭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll pay, you send me half.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, the seat warms up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels great on my back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This driver knows all the shortcuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's driven here for ten years.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says the tunnel is faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's go through the tunnel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tunnel lights blur past the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love how quiet it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus may catch up too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We came out near the office.
dialogue.zh: 出口就在我們公司附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But it's still a long walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the bus get there first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we beat it by minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the drop-off zone is packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðə drɑp ɑf zoʊn ɪz pækt./
dialogue.zh: 就連下車區也擠滿了人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him to stop by the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm tə stɑp baɪ ðə saɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I always look twice before stepping out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlweɪz lʊk twaɪs bɪˈfɔr ˈstɛpɪŋ aʊt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 小心，這段人行道是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy new ones at the mall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No time, my boss is waiting.
dialogue.zh: 沒時間，我主管在等我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry them under the fan then.
dialogue.zh: 那就拿去吹風機下吹乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Man, the crosswalk signal is flashing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They do that all the time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這裡的自行車什麼都不怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That horn behind me sounds angry.
dialogue.zh: 我身後那喇叭按得好凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the scooter lane is jammed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每個騎士都往市中心去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see the light rail coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the elevator with your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ride the tram this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It drops us at the corner.
dialogue.zh: 它會把我們載到那個轉角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I made it, barely on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你的識別證能刷，快進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, the elevator's packed too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the stairs to the fourth floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə stɛrz tə ðə fɔrθ flɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coffee cup is still in the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkɔfi kʌp ɪz stɪl ɪn ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 我的咖啡杯還留在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll buy you a new one here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl baɪ ju ə nu wʌn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡買杯新的給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天不加糖，我在試著改。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and our bus got stuck too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ˈaʊər bʌs ɡɑt stʌk tu./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們的公車也被堵住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I dozed off and missed my stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ doʊzd ɔf ænd mɪst maɪ stɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven, and then I had to walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən, ænd ðɛn aɪ hæd tə wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 十一分鐘，然後還得走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你的鞋子看起來濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A truck splashed the whole sidewalk.
dialogue.zh: 一輛卡車把整條人行道噴濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why your socks are wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you keep your cool?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you read on the train?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when I get a seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我下載了一些放鬆的音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it help with the noise?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It settles me down a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you leave home?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you leave fifteen minutes earlier?
dialogue.zh: 你能早十五分鐘出門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll move my alarm earlier too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 先去買那杯好喝的咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your team meeting is at nine.
dialogue.zh: 你們團隊會議九點開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我還穿著濕襪子要開會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep a spare pair in my drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ə spɛr pɛr ɪn maɪ drɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You plan ahead, I admire that.
dialogue.zh: 你真會預先打算，我佩服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Commuting teaches you a few things.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gate held it for a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡeɪt hɛld ɪt fər ə ˈmɪnɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a second card at work.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ə ˈsɛkənd kɑrd æt wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 我在公司需要一張備用卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the ride home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly an hour in this traffic.
dialogue.zh: 這種車流要將近一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the ride share cost more later?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə raɪd ʃɛr kɔst mɔr ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 晚一點共乘會比較貴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our office gets quiet after seven.
dialogue.zh: 我們辦公室七點後很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the tram is almost empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd rather sit the whole way home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈræðər sɪt ðə hoʊl weɪ hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 我寧願坐完整段回家的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, my legs ache now.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我的腿現在很痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear about the new line?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hɪr əˈbaʊt ðə nu laɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It opens next spring, they say.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope the buses improve too.
dialogue.zh: 我希望公車也變好一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bike path finished yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I bike on summer mornings?
dialogue.zh: 我夏天早上可以騎車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but bring a dry shirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone died on the bus.
dialogue.zh: 我手機在公車上沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge it at your desk tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone wants to work from home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The boss agreed twice a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那樣最糟的日子就有救。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd take Friday off the road.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The station looks like a river.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我要買能隔絕噪音的耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always keep cards in a pouch.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlweɪz kip kɑrdz ɪn ə paʊʧ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then gates can't take them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個改道變成常態了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們把壞掉的電扶梯修好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I rode it up without waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I'll leave right at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me a photo of the empty car.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ði ˈɛmpti kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 拍張空車廂的照片給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wake me if you leave first.
dialogue.zh: 如果你比我早走就叫醒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour each way, every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yet we make it every single day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛt wi meɪk ɪt ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 但我們每一天都辦到了。
